type: six independent whole-game visual-direction frames; fresh generation without image references

prompts.title: Đất dựng thành
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE wide landscape 16:9 FULL GAMEPLAY-SCREEN concept for an experimental offline living-world narrative RPG inspired by Văn Lang–Âu Lạc. Inventive non-photorealistic GAME GRAPHICS, not a historical illustration or photo. The world, people, useful objects and interface must all share the specified visual language. It is an image-only proposal, not an implemented game or real3D scene. Ordinary work, family and consequential social choices matter. Protagonist is an example of a received random life, never a character creator or fixed chosen hero. Cultural shapes are creative extrapolations, not verified archaeology or new canon. No real-world brands, watermark, artistsignature, marketingtitle, characterturnaround/assetcatalogue strip. Use only the specified short Vietnamese interface text; no invented numeric stats, deadlines or omniscient NPC information. Do NOT fall back to the usual sunny riverboat village with the same red-shirt woman, cream-shirt oldman, darkrounded dialoguebox or painterly naturalistic background. Design this direction from the ground up.
VISUAL LANGUAGE: a stark monumental 3D GAME made of huge angular matte volumes and dramatically elongated adult figures. Hard sculptural planes, long forearms/legs, small angular heads, wedgefeet and expressive largehands, simplified solid wraps. NOT the rounded four-head villagers of earlier prototypes; not realistic people either. Geometry feels carved from broad slabs of earth, not stone/concrete buildings or a metallic relief. A sharply controlled THREE-COLOR value system: ironoxide red-orange earth, nearblack charcoal shadow and bonewhite sky/highlights; a tiny strawyellow focusmark only. NO green vegetation or blue river panorama. NO brushstroke, papertexture, pores, clothweave, tinythatche, realisticPBR or lensblur. Lighting is graphic directional daylight casting big sharp shapes; every form has at most two lit/shaded planes.
SCENE/CAMERA: high diagonal camera looking INTO an immense curving EARTH RAMPART UNDER CONSTRUCTION in a LoaVực-inspired locality. Earthramp takes a bold circular/diagonal bite through the image, a timber ramp crosses negative space, simple scaffold/posts and a few unfinished highcurved-roof forms imply a skilledcommunity. Paths and workingpeople large enough to read. Not a castle, not an imperialcity, not an aerialcitybuilder. A youngadult watercarrier protagonist with a tall narrow body and short darkhair carries a plain jar toward two crew members; one older broad woman rests her hands on a timber strut. Their support/weight poses carry the human story. Only the protagonist has a small selected mark. Scene fills the whole frame, continuous beyondedges, not a diorama on a displaybase.
UI: a thin VERTICAL CHARCOAL RIBBON on the RIGHT edge with sharp cutcorner white pictogramicons for eye, talk, journal; exact short labels “Quan sát”, “Hỏi chuyện”, “Nhật ký”. One small bonewhite angular speaker callout near olderworker, no widebottomdialoguebar, no roundbuttons. Protagonist tiny angular profileportrait lowerleft with two minimalist useful-object shapes, in same carvedplanegrammar. Interface should feel austere and tactile in geometry, not ornate fantasy. The visual point is monumental scale and rhythmic angular bodies, not realism or battle.
